# Locales

> Table of 305 locales with metadata, language names (endonym and exonyms), and translated IANA time zone names, from Unicode CLDR 49.0.0.

- [README.md](README.md): column definitions and data sources.
- [locales.tsv](locales.tsv): source of truth. 767 tab-separated columns, one row per locale, keyed by `lowercase_slug`.
- [locales.csv](locales.csv): same data as CSV.
- [locales.json](locales.json): same data as a JSON array of objects; empty cells are null.
